textPreview: Continuation of Deng Zhenglai's Chinese jurisprudence project, helpful for comparing domestic theoretical agendas with global legal knowledge.

title: 中國法學的發展與世界結構_邓正来.pdf

textPreview: Self-framing text for Deng Zhenglai's project on constructing a Chinese legal ideal image, useful as a compact entry into the larger debate.

textPreview: Review and critique of the modernization paradigm in Chinese legal scholarship, paired naturally with Deng Zhenglai materials.

title: 法學中國化問題探索_李芳.pdf
textPreview: Chinese-language exploration of the Sinicization of legal studies, useful for contrasting localization and comparative-law approaches.

textPreview: Seventy-year review of Chinese legal education, with development history, problem reflection, and future outlook.

textPreview: Chinese source on talent cultivation in legal education, relevant to classroom modules about skills, values, and professional formation.

textPreview: Source on legal education during two decades of governing the country according to law, useful for linking legal education to state legal reform.

textPreview: Historical comparative-law source on Roscoe Pound in China, useful for teaching legal transplantation, American influence, and Chinese legal modernization.

title: 刘水林：法学方法论研究（《法学研究》2001年第3期）
textPreview: Foundational mainland article distinguishing methodology from particular methods and mapping positive analysis, normative analysis, individualism, and holism as legal-research categories.

title: 法学研究方法的理论与实践（《法学研究》2013年第6期笔谈）
textPreview: A multi-author symposium on legal method after China's shift from legislation-centered reform toward implementation-centered rule-of-law questions, useful as a map of method debates.

title: 白建军：论法律实证分析（《中国法学》2000年第4期）
textPreview: Early and influential article arguing that Chinese legal scholarship needs empirical analysis to study legal implementation effects, legal experience, and operational questions.

title: 赵骏：中国法律实证研究的回归与超越（《政法论坛》2013年第2期）
textPreview: Concise source on why empirical and normative analysis should interact, with attention to institutional construction, legal transplantation, and evaluation of legal application.

title: 程金华：当代中国的法律实证研究（《中国法学》2015年第6期）
textPreview: Uses legal-periodical and research-project data to describe the emergence, distribution, and limits of empirical legal research in contemporary China.

title: 雷鑫洪：方法论演进视野下的中国法律实证研究（《法学研究》2017年第4期）
textPreview: Tracks Chinese empirical legal research through methodology change, including core-journal publication patterns and the transformation of criminal procedure research methods.

title: 左卫民：实证研究是中国法学的一场范式革命吗？
textPreview: Important argument for treating data-based empirical legal research as a distinct and increasingly influential Chinese legal-research paradigm.

title: 陈柏峰：法律实证研究的兴起与分化（《中国法学》2018年第3期）
textPreview: Historicizes China's empirical legal research and explains the differentiation between quantitative empirical legal research and qualitative legal-experience research.

title: 张永健、程金华：法律实证研究的方法坐标（《中国法律评论》2018年第6期）
textPreview: A central map for teaching legal empirical research: defines qualitative and quantitative empirical legal studies and places them relative to doctrinal and socio-legal methods.

title: 程金华：迈向科学的法律实证研究（《清华法学》2018年第4期）
textPreview: Methodological intervention on making empirical legal research more scientific while guarding against over-technical or poorly theorized statistical work.

title: 缪因知：计量与案例：法律实证研究方法的细剖析（《北方法学》2014年第3期）
textPreview: Breaks empirical legal research into quantitative research and case research, then compares subtypes and their strengths and limits.

title: 刘庄：法学中的实验方法（《中国法律评论》2018年第6期）
textPreview: Introduces experimental methods as a legal-research tool, suitable for teaching how causal questions about legal reasoning and legal decision-making can be tested.

title: 何挺：法学研究中裁判文书运用的方法论检讨（《法学研究》2022年第3期）
textPreview: Uses content analysis of criminal-law scholarship to critique how researchers collect, sample, report, and interpret judgment-document data.

title: 侯猛：实证包装法学？法律的实证研究在中国（《中国法律评论》2020年第4期）
textPreview: A cautionary source for distinguishing genuine empirical legal research from merely labeling conventional legal arguments as empirical.

title: 彭小龙：法实证研究中的理论问题（《法制与社会发展》2022年第4期）
textPreview: Explains why empirical legal research still needs theory: analytical frameworks connect legal concepts, social facts, and causal explanations.

title: 熊丙万、王军乐：基于裁判文书数据的法实证研究方法（《经贸法律评论》2023年第6期）
textPreview: Uses the知假买假 problem to show how legal questions can be translated into information extraction, data quality assessment, and cautious empirical inference from judgments.

title: 熊谋林：实证法学的概念术语回顾与回归（《湖湘法学评论》2024年第1期）
textPreview: Reconstructs the terminology around empirical, quantitative, computational, data, and digital legal studies, arguing for conceptual integration around实证法学.

title: 中外实证法律分析之不同：研究范畴与知识基础（《山东大学学报》2025年第3期）
textPreview: Recent comparison of Chinese and international empirical legal analysis, useful for discussing differences in research scope, knowledge base, and evidence-oriented reasoning.

title: 王鹏翔、张永健：经验面向的规范意义（《中研院法学期刊》2015年第17期）
textPreview: A major Chinese-language account of how empirical facts can matter to doctrinal and normative argument, especially through causal inference and effectiveness analysis.

title: 张永健：法实证研究方法论：实证比较法的五种取径（《月旦法学杂志》2022年第326期）
textPreview: Introduces five approaches to empirical comparative law, including empirical comparison of legal norms, institutional outcomes, reverse comparative law, and causal support for comparative claims.

title: 吴义龙：社科法学如何处理规范性问题？（《中外法学》2022年第6期）
textPreview: Clarifies how socio-legal research can handle normativity, making it useful for teaching the boundary and cooperation between facts, values, and doctrinal reasoning.

title: 贺剑：法教义学的巅峰：德国法律评注文化及其中国前景考察（《中外法学》2017年第2期）
textPreview: Uses German legal-commentary culture to explain legal dogmatics as a method, source genre, and bridge between scholarship, adjudication, legislation, and legal education.

title: 陈兴良：刑法教义学方法论（《法学研究》2005年第2期）
textPreview: Classic department-law methodology article for teaching doctrinal reasoning, legal interpretation, and the internal method of criminal-law scholarship.

title: 李晟：实践视角下的社科法学：以法教义学为对照
textPreview: Useful bridge text for teaching socio-legal inquiry as a practice-oriented method contrasted with but not wholly opposed to legal dogmatics.

title: 侯猛：社科法学的传统与挑战（《法商研究》2014年第5期相关文本）
textPreview: Explains socio-legal studies as a social-science method of analyzing legal problems and places it in the Chinese debate with doctrinal scholarship.

title: 苏力：为什么研究中国基层司法制度：送法下乡导论（《法商研究》2000年第3期）
textPreview: A classic exemplar of bringing field observation, institutional detail, and social-science concepts into Chinese legal research on grassroots courts.

title: 强世功：法律是如何实践的？一起乡村民事调解案的分析
textPreview: A close reading of a rural civil mediation process, useful as a concrete model for process-event analysis, legal pluralism, and law-in-action teaching.

title: 程金华：法律人从政：合理性分析及其验证（《中外法学》2013年第1期）
textPreview: A useful quantitative-comparative example that tests claims about lawyers in politics using OECD leadership-background data and performance indicators.

title: 程金华：检察人员对分类管理改革的立场：以问卷调查为基础（《法学研究》2015年第4期）
textPreview: Questionnaire-based study of 1,748 prosecutors across seven provinces and cities, useful for teaching survey design, stakeholder analysis, and reform evaluation.

title: 大数据分析：中国司法裁判文书上网公开报告（《中国法律评论》2016年第4期）
textPreview: Large-scale report on China Judgments Online, combining data extraction, database construction, quantitative assessment, and field interviews about judicial transparency.

title: 唐应茂：司法公开及其决定因素：基于中国裁判文书网的数据分析（《清华法学》2018年第4期）
textPreview: Uses China Judgments Online data to study provincial publication rates and determinants of judicial transparency, including authority, marketization, and public trust.

title: 唐应茂：领导意愿、机构能力和司法公开（《中国法律评论》2018年第6期）
textPreview: Focused empirical study of Beijing, Shanghai, and Guangdong court-opinion publication rates, useful for teaching how leadership incentives and institutional capacity become variables.

title: 李学尧、刘庄：矫饰的技术：司法说理与判决中的偏见（《中国法律评论》2022年第2期）
textPreview: Experimental legal-cognition exemplar examining how legal reasoning can mask judicial bias, good for teaching variables, experimental design, and doctrinal implications.

title: 苏凯平：再访法实证研究概念与价值：以简单量化方法研究我国减刑政策为例（《台大法学论丛》2016年第45卷第3期）
textPreview: Demonstrates how simple descriptive statistics can uncover legally important facts about commutation policy and make empirical legal research accessible.

title: 张永健：比较法作为双重因果推理：以修正民事诉讼法影响和解率的实证研究为例（《中研院法学期刊》2024年第34期）
textPreview: Strong exemplar for combining comparative law, legal-economic theory, and empirical causal reasoning through settlement-rate changes after civil-procedure reforms.
